snippet.title: Exterminauts Developer Diary - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4039200/Exterminauts/
Vincent Regimbald from Behaviour Interactive dropped by the Future Games Show to talk more about Exterminauts, the studio's blue-collar pest control shooter, where players complete work orders with friends in tow. It's coming to PC & consoles in 2027.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
